BEP 52 piece layers the metadata does not hold yet: one per file of

wanted_done.description: Bytes of wanted pieces verified and written.

info.description:
HTTP/JSON control of an fbt BitTorrent session: torrents, session settings, server-sent events and byte-range file streaming.

Every route needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, except this document. The streaming and event routes also take `?token=<token>`. Errors are `{"error": {"code": "<snake_case>", "message": "<text>"}}`.
info.title: fbt API

post.description:
Runs on the blocking pool, two at a time; a third request gets
`503 busy`. Hashing reads every byte, so a large source takes a while.
